title: GariFieldDatasetRecord
description: Standard schema for Vietnam agricultural field images, metadata, and multi-level disease annotations.

id.description: Unique identifier for the field image (UUID or prefixed hash, e.g. field_1793374901234).

filename.description: Image file basename stored in images/ directory.

filepath.description: Relative path to image from dataset root (e.g. images/coffee_rust_001.jpg).

crop_id.description: Canonical English crop ID (e.g. Coffee, Black_Pepper, Rice, Durian, Rubber, Dragon_Fruit, Tomato, Potato, Unknown).

crop_name_vi.description: Standard Vietnamese crop name (e.g. Cà phê, Hồ tiêu, Lúa, Sầu riêng, Cao su, Thanh long, Cà chua, Khoai tây, Chưa rõ cây trồng).

compatible_model_exists.description: Explicit declaration whether a neural model exists in models/ registry for this crop.

health_status.description: Status of the plant tissue: healthy (khỏe mạnh), abnormal (bất thường/mầm bệnh), or unknown (chưa rõ).

disease_id.description: Standard disease ID if identified, null if healthy or unknown.

disease_name_vi.description: Vietnamese disease name (e.g. Bệnh gỉ sắt cà phê, Đốm nâu hại lúa, Cháy lá chết nhanh hồ tiêu).

is_verified.description: True only if verified by an agronomist or PCR/laboratory test.

environment.description: Physical environment where the photo was taken.

province.description: Province/City in Vietnam (e.g. Đắk Lắk, Lâm Đồng, Gia Lai, Cần Thơ, Tiền Giang, Bình Phước, Đồng Nai).

district.description: District name (e.g. Cư M'gar, Di Linh, Chư Sê, Phong Điền, Cái Bè).

enum: Đồng bằng sông Cửu Long (Mekong Delta)
Duyên hải Nam Trung Bộ (South Central Coast)
Đồng bằng sông Hồng (Red River Delta)
Trung du và miền núi phía Bắc (Northern Midlands & Mountains)

session_id.description: Collection session ID to prevent data leakage during train/eval splitting.

localization.description: Multi-tier lesion spatial annotations (bounding boxes, polygons, and pixel masks).

has_manual_annotations.description: Set to true ONLY when a human annotator manually drew the boxes/polygons.

box_xywh.description: [x_min, y_min, width, height] in pixel coordinates.

points.description: List of [x, y] coordinates forming closed polygon outline.

mask_file.description: Relative path to binary/indexed PNG mask file for pixel-level ground truth.

annotation_status.description: Review status: pending (chờ duyệt), reviewed (đã duyệt sơ bộ), verified (đã xác thực chuyên gia), disputed (tranh chấp/chưa thống nhất nhãn).
